subject: Request: interim coverage bridgenote for post-report period / Lyricore
messages:
From: Elena Martins <elena@lyricore.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request for interim coverage note (bridge letter)

Hi Naomi,

Hope you’re well — we’re preparing for an internal security review and our procurement team has asked for an interim assurance covering the period after the end date on Redwood’s SOC 2 Type II report (period ended 2027-12-31) through today. Specifically they want either: 1) a short management assertion/bridge letter that confirms there have been no material changes to the control environment since the report end date, or 2) an auditor-signed interim attestation if Redwood’s auditors can provide one.

Can you confirm what you can provide and the typical turnaround? Our legal/compliance team also asked for:
- a one-paragraph statement of controls unchanged (change/no-change)
- affirmation of any exceptions since 2027-12-31 (if any)
- list of evidence items (KMS, access review cadence, incident log summary) available on request

If you have a template or draft, can you send it over? We’d like to include it in our vendor package by EOD Friday.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Elena Martins
Head of Vendor Risk, Lyricore Therapeutics
elena@lyricore.com
+1 415-555-0189
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: 2028-03-05T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request for interim coverage note (bridge letter)

Forwarding Lyricore’s ask — they want a bridgenote for the gap from Redwood SOC2 period-end (2027-12-31) to present. Attached: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2027.pdf and I started a draft bridgenote (draft-bridgenote-lyricore.docx).

Quick asks:
- Kar (security): can you confirm whether we have any control changes or exceptions in the post-report period that would prevent a simple management assertion? If no changes, please suggest 1-2 lines we can use.
- Lauren (rev ops/legal): will we be okay providing a management assertion only, or do we need to route to AuditPartners for an auditor-signed interim attestation if buyer requires it? Any approvals needed?
- Priyom (AE): heads-up — this is Lyricore (prospect) and they asked for EOD Friday. Please coordinate client expectations on whether auditor signature is required.

If we can do a management assertion, I think we can turn around in 48–72 hrs. If AuditPartners needs to sign, timeline will be longer (~7–10 business days).

[Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2027.pdf]
[Attachment: draft-bridgenote-lyricore.docx]

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Director, Trust & Security, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com
From: Karithik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-05T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request for interim coverage note (bridge letter)

Thanks for the ping — quick status:
- Controls: no material control changes since 2027-12-31. We’ve had routine patching, monthly access reviews (last done 2028-02-28), and two low-severity incident records (both contained, postmortems posted to Confluence). Nothing that changes the Type II conclusions.
- Evidence we can provide on short notice: recent access review report (redacted), KMS rotation log (summary), incident log excerpt, SOC control owner confirmations.
- For the bridgenote language I recommend a short management assertion: "Based on our processes and control monitoring, Redwood Inference confirms that, except as disclosed, there have been no material changes to the control environment described in the SOC 2 Type II report covering the period ending 2027-12-31 through [current date]."

If Lyricore needs an auditor-signed letter, we’ll need to route to AuditPartners; I can coordinate but will need a PO or engagement request from Lyricore and that will add time and some cost.

Estimate: 48–72 hrs for a management assertion + evidence bundle; 7–12 business days for an auditor-signed interim attestation.

-Kar
Karithik Iyer
Senior Manager, Security Assurance, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martins <elena@lyricore.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-07T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request for interim coverage note (bridge letter)

Hi Elena — thanks for the details and the deadline note. Per our internal review: we can provide a management assertion bridgenote plus an evidence bundle within 48–72 hours.

What we will deliver (sample package):
- One-page management assertion (bridgenote) signed by our Head of Security (sample attached)
- Evidence bundle (redacted access review, KMS rotation summary, incident log excerpt, control-owner confirmations)
- Copy of our SOC 2 Type II report (attached)

If Lyricore requires an auditor-signed interim attestation, please confirm now — that requires an engagement with AuditPartners and will add ~7–12 business days and a fee. If you do not require auditor sign-off, we will proceed with the management assertion.

Next steps:
1) Confirm whether auditor signature is necessary.
2) If no auditor, confirm the name/email to sign the bridgenote and we’ll send the package by end of business Friday (2028-03-09).

Attached: draft-bridgenote-lyricore.docx; Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2027.pdf

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com
